name: strand
info: Orientation of the variant relative to the reference

name: filter
info: Comma-separated list of filters applied to this record or empty if the record was not filtered

name: qryRegion
info: Location of this variant in the assembly

name: invOuter
info: Outer inversion coordinates including flanking inverted repeats

name: varScore
info: Score assigned by the PAV score model

name: varIndex
info: Unique index of this variant within the callset it was called in

name: templRes
info: True if templated sites are resolved, False if large regions of the variant are unaligned

name: alignSource
info: Comma-separated list of alignment record indexes supporting this variant

name: seg
info: Comma-separated list of variant segments formatted as "chrom:pos-end(strand)>qry_id:qry_pos-qry_end"

name: dup
info: Comma-separated list of duplicated loci formatted as "chrom:pos-end(strand)"

name: segN
info: Number of aligned and unaligned segments in a complex event

name: alignGap
info: For alignment-truncating INVs, the difference between the aligned (inverted) segment and gap between flanking segments (closer to 0 is a clean INV, high numbers point to complex breakpoints)

name: derived
info: Derived from this variant (e.g. a duplication may be derived from an insertion)

name: discord
info: Comma-separated list of variants this record is discordant with

name: inner
info: Comma-separated list of variants this record is embedded in

name: mgSrc
info: Comma-separated list of merged callset sources formatted as "sample:hap:var_id" (merged callsets only)

name: mgStat
info: Comma-separated list of merge statistics formatted as "ro:offset_dist:offset_prop:size_ro:match_prop:weight", one per non-lead source (merged callsets only). match_prop is empty for variant types merged without sequence matching (SNV, INV, DUP)

name: mgSrcLead
info: Index into the merge source list of the lead (representative) source (merged callsets only)
